description: Japan MLIT National Land Numerical Information provides Japan's National Land Numerical Information collection of GIS layers for transport, facilities, land use and hazards. The provider is Japan Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism. Geographical and temporal coverage: The MLIT national portal lists current and historical editions with version-specific usage conditions. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. data-japan-ksj-roads-n01 and data-japan-ksj-water-supply-facilities-p21 cover specific layers. This record describes their broader national source catalogue.
